text.content:
The Tyger Claws' masked enforcers in Kabuki.

Turf: Kabuki, by day and on the main streets; part of Japantown with the NCPD
Known for: Oni masks; Kabuki's day-to-day security (SC 6, Hardened Light)
Leadership: Kenta Ishida
Allies & rivals: Part of the Tyger Claws. They chase the G4 across the rooftops and rarely catch one
Hangouts: Ho-Oh (#76), the Kabuki Roundabout (#5)

In 2045 the Kimen-Gumi made Kabuki one of the safest districts in the city, keeping the streets orderly for the Japanese diaspora. As the Co-Prosperity Sphere's firms pull out and their people follow, the Chinese, Korean and Vietnamese diasporas are moving into the empty storefronts. The Kimen-Gumi still wear their oni masks, but they look the other way on anything that pays the Claws.

They answer calls in Kabuki in place of the NCPD. The Mox hold Lizzie's and every dollhouse back door, and neither side goes into the other's places. Their head, Kenta Ishida, is old school, honorable by his own rules, and unhappy about the new Shinobu. They have a price on G4 leader Sora Ihara's head that nobody has collected.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.03, 04, 08
